name: Stormbringer: Residual Power reduces magic damage taken (#3414)
contract: #3414: Residual Power (804605) is a passive (Attributes 464, IS_ABILITY|PASSIVE|DO_NOT_DISPLAY|DO_NOT_LOG) with effect 0 = APPLY_AURA, EffectImplicitTargetA[0] = 1 TARGET_UNIT_CASTER (so the parity contract's enemy-implicit-target trap does not apply), EffectApplyAuraName[0] = 87 SPELL_AURA_MOD_DAMAGE_PERCENT_TAKEN, EffectMiscValue[0] = 126 = SPELL_SCHOOL_MASK_MAGIC (SharedDefines.h:368), EffectBasePoints[0] = -11 + DieSides 1 = -10%. Unit::SpellDamageBonusTaken (Unit.cpp:9423-9431) multiplies by GetTotalAuraMultiplier(SPELL_AURA_MOD_DAMAGE_PERCENT_TAKEN) gated on effect->GetMiscValue() & spellProto->GetSchoolMask(); Unit.cpp:9407 early-returns only for melee DIRECT_DAMAGE, and the harness's spell_damage_taken metric passes SPELL_DIRECT_DAMAGE (CoAGameplayTest.cpp:1083-1092), so the aura is visible to the metric. The issue body mislabels aura 87 as 'Mod Power Regen'; this core's SpellAuraDefines.h:150 defines 87 as SPELL_AURA_MOD_DAMAGE_PERCENT_TAKEN, and the DBC record's own school-mask/target fields match the tooltip's magic-damage-reduction clause exactly. 804605's only source occurrence is AscensionStockCoefficientData.h:116 (the EffectBonusMultiplier-zeroing list, not a handler); no module code exists or is needed. The magic-school probe is Shock (804020, SchoolMask 8, a subset of magic mask 126) and the physical control is Heroic Strike (78, SchoolMask 1), which is outside the school-mask gate and must stay untouched to distinguish the mask-gated reduction from a blanket one. spell_damage_taken always starts from a fixed base of 1000 (CoAGameplayTest.cpp:1091), so 1000 x (1 + (-10)/100) = 900 is the expected post-learn reading on Shock.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
BASELINE #3414: magic-school damage taken is unmodified without Residual Power
BASELINE #3414 control: physical damage taken is unmodified without Residual Power
SETUP #3414: Residual Power is applied to the caster
DISCRIMINATING #3414: Residual Power reduces magic-school damage taken by 10%
DISCRIMINATING #3414 control: physical damage taken still equals 1000 (the school mask, not a blanket reduction, distinguishes the effect)
